stem: Mark every value $x$ cannot take in $\frac{1}{(x {=('+' if r > 0 else '-') + str(abs(r))})(x {=('+' if s > 0 else '-') + str(abs(s))})}$.
solution: The fraction breaks wherever the denominator is zero.
Set the whole denominator to zero and solve it completely — every factor gives one root.
Both are excluded. The domain is every real number except those two.
notes: Reproduces the live template exactly, as corrected in v0.9.3 (migration 032): the targets are the stem's zeros -r and -s, and the sign error is diagnosed first. Until v0.9.3 the targets were [r, s], the shifts the stem prints; the blind-verifier tests rebuild that defect from this file and must refuse it.
